release.title: Mian Zhang at KDD 2026: Two Workshop Papers
release.status: two accepted and presented non-archival KDD 2026 workshop papers

papers.title: ReflexBench: Evaluating Observer-Participant Failures and Counterfactual Trustworthiness in Agentic AI
papers.author: Mian Zhang
papers.venue: KDD 2026 Workshop on Evaluation and Trustworthiness of Agentic AI
papers.location: ICC Jeju, Jeju, Republic of Korea
papers.archival_status: non-archival workshop paper; not included in KDD proceedings
papers.reported_signal: All tested models degraded at deeper observer levels; rounded mean shallow-to-deep degradation about -0.44.
boundaries: not domain simulation or real deployment
full row-level uncertainty and scorer statistics require retained row-level records

papers.title: Cognitive Immunity for Trustworthy LLM Agents: Auditable Failure Memory Against Repeated Safety Errors
papers.author: Mian Zhang
papers.venue: 2nd SeT-LLM Workshop on Secure and Trustworthy Large Language Models at KDD 2026
papers.location: ICC Jeju, Jeju, Republic of Korea
papers.archival_status: non-archival workshop paper; no official proceedings
papers.tradeoff: Reflexion retained the highest WQ point estimate; Cognitive Immunity does not dominate every metric.
boundaries: score-level recovered arrays, not public raw-response replication
memory poisoning and overblocking remain risks
not a replacement for red teaming, access control, sandboxing, or human oversight
